caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest-like garment with a high, round neckline. The vest is yellow or cream-colored and is decorated with small, repeating blue floral motifs spread across the front. It features a blue decorative border that runs along the edge of the collar, down the front opening, and around the hem. The front has two large, angular pocket flaps at the lower part, each flap also decorated with intricate blue floral embroidery and a bordering blue line. Buttons are visible along the front closure and are surrounded by blue stitched loops. To the upper right of the main colored rendering, there is a simple line drawing outlining the back view of the vest, showing seam lines and the shape but with no color or decorative detail. The background is plain and light beige.
title: Waistcoat
